verdict.rationale: Fern's CLI can generate SDKs across many languages and publish docs in one command, and the Fern Agent automation can scan reader feedback, search queries, and unanswered questions in bulk before opening a PR — both are forms of batch/bulk processing. However, there's no evidence of bulk operations on the documentation content itself (e.g., mass-editing many pages, bulk API endpoint updates, or batch content migrations beyond the one-time Enterprise migration service). Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch-update tooling across many docs pages or API entities, and any documented limits/scale for how many items the CLI or Agent can process in one run.
